attack_techniques: Exfiltration Over Physical Medium: Exfiltration over USB (T1052.001)
attackers_goals: Collect data and stage it on an endpoint in the organization.
description: A user generated abnormal massive file activity to a connected USB storage device.
investigative_actions: Check whether the process that created the massive file activity creates network connections as well. Check whether the USB storage device is new to the organization. Check whether other users in the organization used the same process for massive file activity.
name: Possible internal data exfiltration over a USB storage device
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)

variations.name: Possible internal data exfiltration of over 500 MB via USB storage device
